gui.help.title: Help
gui.help.what.title: What the app does
gui.help.what.body: When an app opens the headset microphone, Windows switches a Bluetooth headset to the Hands-Free (HFP) call profile and the sound becomes mono and muffled. HandsFree Toggle shows when this happens and brings back stereo A2DP sound.
gui.help.fix.title: Fix sound
gui.help.fix.body: Restarts the HFP service without changing its startup type, so the microphone keeps working. A hung service is recovered automatically: its process is ended only when it hosts nothing but HFP services.
gui.help.hard.title: Hard mode
gui.help.hard.body: Turns HFP off for the whole system: the sound is always stereo, but the headset microphone stops working. The original service state is saved first, and turning the switch off restores it exactly.
gui.help.mic.title: If the sound drops to mono again
gui.help.mic.body: While any app records from the headset microphone, Windows keeps the headset in call mode. The panel names these apps: close them or choose another microphone in their settings. If the headset is the default microphone, choose another one in Windows Sound settings.
gui.help.safety.title: Safety
gui.help.safety.body: Checking the status needs no special rights. Changing services needs administrator rights, so Windows asks for permission each time. Nothing else on the system is changed.
gui.help.limits.title: Limitation
gui.help.limits.body: Bluetooth Classic cannot give A2DP quality and an HFP microphone at the same time. This is a limit of the protocol, not a bug.
